property_summary: For any inputs, C always reverts the whole transfer call if any single external transferFrom call to caddress fails; the mutant that drops the require allows transfer(...) to return true even when an external call fails, so there exist inputs (a failing callee) where the mutant does not revert but the reference does.
change_summary: Remove the require(_s) after the external call so a failing call does not revert the function.
